commit.message: Address review comments and extend the test

8387149: C2: assert(regs[i] != regs[j]) failed: regs[2] and regs[3] are both: v24

The failing assertion checks, among other conditions, that both:
  - src1 != index
  - src2 != index

The select_from_two_vectors* do not actually rely on these two
conditions and the conditions are not always satisfied in practice
as demonstrated by the test.

Split the assertions into two, separately for src1/src2 and for index.
Also, remove assertions for dst and src1 in those of the functions that
do not rely on these registers being distinct from the other registers.
